subject: Workplace Skills
title: Your Boss Is Human Too
description: One-minute skill: Your Boss Is Human Too.

hook.text: A Gallup study found that 70% of employee engagement variance is directly tied to the manager relationship.

buildup.text: Most people see their boss as an authority figure. Rarely do they consider what pressures the boss faces.

discovery.text: Your boss has their own boss, their own deadlines, and their own fears. Understanding this changes your approach.

twist.text: Empathy flows up, not just down. The employee who understands their boss's world gains an enormous advantage.

climax.text: Ask what keeps your boss up at night. Then position your work as a solution to that worry.

punchline.text: Understand their pressure. Then ease it.

quiz.question: Why does understanding your boss's pressures give you an advantage?
options: It lets you exploit their weaknesses
You can position your work as a solution to their biggest concerns
It makes you their personal therapist
